title: A Feather page (feather.page/1)
description: A website as data: one document renders a complete, themeable site; changing brand restyles all of it. Generated from packages/page/src/core/spec.ts by scripts/generate.ts; validatePage is the authority.

nav.description: The overlay menu: a minimal bar whose Menu opens a full-screen list of large links.

footer.description: The last scene. plain: links and a note. wordmark: the name set as large as the width allows. reveal: the footer waits behind the page and is uncovered as it ends.

notFound.description: The 404, as a small scene with a clear way home. type: the number as display type. minimal: the words alone.

loader.description: Arrival. counter: an honest percentage that lifts off. dock: a bar that fills and becomes the header. Never shown without script or under reduced motion.

sound.description: One ambient bed, off until the person turns it on; the toggle sits in the nav.
